answer: Concrete sybil resistance via basalt anchoring: each agent must lock a basalt stake of 20,000 POA for 22 epochs; the stake weathers 3% per epoch unless reforged by valid work proofs. A comet of 17 orbiting auditors samples each epoch's output; outputs diverging from consensus are incinerated and the stake burns 28%. At the mesa of each new epoch, validators are resampled from the top 40 reputation holders. An attacker running N sybils must lock 20,000N POA for 22 epochs and survive 17 audits per epoch per identity, so cost scales as N^2 while detection probability compounds per head.
